command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp
echo "== verify staged ChIP + control against pinned sha256 =="
{ printf '%s  %s\n' 32db48ec96a8680108f745df6abee2b52d775eb539ccc268184a9e9a88cb6a2a ctcf_chr20.bam
  printf '%s  %s\n' a33c376a1fb9b3eb820b268495b0bd0fb5df4f3b29076049950c99a11a3e5ef5 input_chr20.bam
} > pins.sha256
sha256sum -c pins.sha256

echo "== macs2 callpeak: CTCF treatment vs matched input control (single-end -f BAM) =="
macs2 callpeak -t ctcf_chr20.bam -c input_chr20.bam -f BAM -g hs -n ctcf --outdir out 2>&1 | tee macs2.log
cp out/ctcf_peaks.narrowPeak peaks.narrowPeak

# ---- smoke check ----
PEAKS=$(grep -vc '^#' peaks.narrowPeak)
{
  echo "peaks           $PEAKS   want exactly 1390  (CTCF chr20 vs input control; bit-identical on local Apple arm64 AND Graviton4)"
  echo "enrichment_real $([ "$PEAKS" -ge 1000 ] && echo yes || echo no)   want yes (a matched-control sharp-factor ChIP is enriched, NOT the degenerate 0-peak WGS case)"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt
test "$PEAKS" -eq 1390
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
